info.title: Simple Comment API
info.description: A REST OpenAPI 3.0 Comment API. Cookie-authenticated writes require a trusted origin. Cross-site embeds must explicitly configure their origin and enable IS_CROSS_SITE.

get.description: Lists topics. Authentication is required when public discussion reads are disabled.

404.description: Authenticating user is unknown and public discussion reads are disabled

403.description: User is not authorized to create topics. Cookie-authenticated writes from untrusted origins are forbidden.

404.description: Authenticating user is unknown when first-visit creation is disabled

requestBody.description: Supply a lowercase topic ID using letters, digits, and hyphens. The other fields are title and isLocked. Send ampersand-separated key=value pairs with percent-encoded values. Encode spaces as %20 and literal plus signs as %2B.

post.description: When the first-visit creation policy is enabled, anonymous visitors and non-admin callers can create topics with an allowed Referer. When disabled, topic creation requires an authenticated administrator.

parameters.name: Referer
parameters.description: Required for callers without an authenticated administrator account when first-visit creation is enabled.

get.description: Returns the topic and its replies. Authentication is required when public discussion reads are disabled. Discussion replies are filtered for the viewer. Redacted ancestors preserve the structure of visible replies. Manually hidden comments appear as redacted placeholders even when they have no replies.

403.description: Administrator access is required to edit the topic. Cookie-authenticated writes from untrusted origins are forbidden.

requestBody.description: Send the title and isLocked values to set. Send ampersand-separated key=value pairs with percent-encoded values. Encode spaces as %20 and literal plus signs as %2B.

403.description: Administrator access is required to delete the topic. Cookie-authenticated writes from untrusted origins are forbidden.

404.description: Topic or authenticating user was not found

201.description: Comment saved. Publication status and any hold reason are included.

403.description: User is not authorized to post this comment. Cookie-authenticated writes from untrusted origins are forbidden.

404.description: Parent topic, parent comment, or authenticating user was not found

409.description: The same text was already posted by this user in their most recent comment on this parent

get.summary: View specific comment and its descendants

200.description: Viewer-appropriate comment or deleted-comment placeholder, with visible replies

404.description: Comment does not exist or is unavailable to the viewer

get.description: Returns a viewer-appropriate comment and its replies. Authors and moderators can see held content and reasons. Other viewers receive a redacted placeholder for a manually hidden comment, including a comment with no replies. An automatically held comment is replaced by a placeholder when visible descendants require its ancestry. For an existing deleted comment, returns 200 with a placeholder (including id, dateDeleted, null text, and visible replies), even if it has no visible replies or was never published. The recorded removal reason is included only for the original author and moderators. Deleted text, former hold details, author information and private deletion metadata are not returned. Existing discussion read permissions apply.

200.description: Comment saved with its current publication status

400.description: Missing request body or unchanged comment text

403.description: User is not authorized to update this comment. Cookie-authenticated writes from untrusted origins are forbidden.

put.description: Only the original author can edit the comment. Changed text is saved and its publication status is re-evaluated.

400.description: A deletion reason is required for cross-author removal

403.description: User is not authorized to delete this comment. Cookie-authenticated writes from untrusted origins are forbidden.

404.description: Comment or authenticating user was not found

delete.description: Authors can delete their own comments. Moderators can remove another author's comment by supplying a reason. Deletion removes the text and retains the thread record.

requestBody.description: A non-empty plain-text reason is required for cross-author removal.

post.description: An authenticated moderator can place a manual hold on a published comment by supplying a non-blank reason. The comment keeps its text and replies.

requestBody.description: The moderator's reason for hiding the comment.

403.description: Caller lacks moderation privileges. Cookie-authenticated writes from untrusted origins are forbidden.

404.description: Comment was deleted or could not be found

post.description: An authenticated moderator can approve a held comment if its current text matches what the moderator reviewed. Repeated approvals of a published comment succeed without changing it.

requestBody.description: The exact comment text reviewed by the moderator.

200.description: The reviewed text was approved or the comment was already approved

403.description: Reviewer lacks moderation privileges. Cookie-authenticated writes from untrusted origins are forbidden.

404.description: Comment was deleted or could not be found

409.description: The current held text differs from the text submitted for approval

get.description: Lists public profile fields. An authenticated administrator receives additional fields.

post.description: Anonymous registration is available when public user creation is enabled. Guest registration is subject to the guest creation policy.

requestBody.description: Supply id, name, and email. Regular accounts require a password of at least seven characters, with no leading or trailing whitespace. Common passwords are rejected. Guest registration uses the guest ID and may omit the password. Only administrators can supply isVerified. Requests containing privilege, isModerator, isAdmin, or isOwner are rejected with HTTP 403. Send ampersand-separated key=value pairs with percent-encoded values. Encode spaces as %20 and literal plus signs as %2B.

403.description: Requesting user is not authorized. Cookie-authenticated writes from untrusted origins are forbidden.
User is not authorized to view this user

get.description: Anonymous and guest access depend on the user profile read policy. The profile owner and administrators receive additional fields.

put.description: Users can update permitted fields on their own profile. Editing another user requires administrator privileges strictly above the target's privilege. The configured owner's identity fields are managed through deployment configuration.

400.description: Missing request body or invalid user details

403.description: User is not authorized to update this user. Cookie-authenticated writes from untrusted origins are forbidden.

requestBody.description: Supply the user fields to update: name and email. Only administrators can set isVerified, and guest accounts cannot be verified through this operation. Requests containing privilege, isModerator, isAdmin, or isOwner are rejected with HTTP 403. Send ampersand-separated key=value pairs with percent-encoded values. Encode spaces as %20 and literal plus signs as %2B.

delete.description: Administrators can delete users. A signed-in non-guest user can delete their own account when self-deletion is enabled. The built-in moderator account is protected.

403.description: User is not authorized to delete this user. Cookie-authenticated writes from untrusted origins are forbidden.

post.summary: Log in with HTTP Basic credentials
post.description: Send the user ID or email and password in the HTTP Basic Authorization header. A successful login sets the simple_comment_token cookie.

Set-Cookie.description: Sets the HttpOnly simple_comment_token cookie to the JWT. The cookie uses SameSite=Strict or SameSite=None with Secure, depending on the deployment configuration.

401.description: HTTP Basic credentials are missing or invalid

WWW-Authenticate.description: HTTP Basic challenge sent when HTTP Basic authentication is absent.

delete.summary: Log out by expiring the session cookie
delete.description: Expires the simple_comment_token cookie in the browser. Previously issued JWTs remain valid until their own expiration.

Set-Cookie.description: Sets simple_comment_token to logged-out with an expiration date in the past.

403.description: The cookie-authenticated logout request came from an untrusted origin

get.description: Sets the simple_comment_token cookie on a successful request. The response body is OK by default.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Any non-empty value returns the JWT in the response body. If omitted or empty, the response body is OK.

200.description: Guest token issued. The body contains OK or the JWT, depending on the token query parameter.

Set-Cookie.description: Sets the HttpOnly simple_comment_token cookie to the JWT. The cookie uses SameSite=Strict or SameSite=None with Secure, depending on the deployment configuration.

403.description: Guest accounts are forbidden according to policy `isGuestAccountAllowed:false`

get.summary: Verify a token and return its claims
get.description: Send the JWT in the simple_comment_token cookie or as an HTTP Bearer token. If both are present, the cookie takes precedence.

exp.description: Expiration time in seconds since the Unix epoch

iat.description: Issuance time in seconds since the Unix epoch

userId.description: Author ID when included. Comment reads omit this field.

isApproved.description: Whether a live comment is published. Legacy live comments without a stored value are treated as approved.

isManuallyHeld.description: Present and true for a manually hidden comment, including its public placeholder. The moderator account ID is omitted.

heldReason.description: The active hold reason, visible to the author and moderators.

deletedReason.description: The recorded removal reason, visible to the original author and moderators.

Comment.description: The comment representation is filtered for the viewer. A placeholder has null text and omits author information. A held placeholder carries isApproved false, and a deletion record carries dateDeleted.

privilege.description: Effective server-derived privilege. 0 is a regular user, 1 is a moderator, 2 is an administrator, and 3 is the configured owner.

isModerator.description: True if the effective privilege is at least 1.

isAdmin.description: True if the effective privilege is at least 2.

isOwner.description: True for the configured owner with effective privilege 3.

BearerAuth.description: JWT sent in the Authorization header

CookieAuth.name: simple_comment_token
CookieAuth.description: JWT issued in the login cookie
